title: How Does a Servo Know Exactly Where to Stop? 🤔 #shorts
description:
A servo never measures an angle — it reads a pulse. Here's the exact math it uses to stop in the right place.
⚙️ The PWM pulse that encodes the target angle
📏 How 1ms, 1.5ms, and 2ms map to 0°, 90°, 180°
🔄 The potentiometer that reports the real angle
❗ How SHOULD BE, IS, and ERROR drive the motor
